title: LoreFountain Workspace Configuration
description: Project-owned configuration for the LoreFountain VS Code extension. Lives at the workspace root as lorefountain.config.json.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference, for editors/tools that resolve it independently of VS Code's own schema association.

folders.description: Workspace-relative folder names. Any field left unset uses its documented default.

world.description: Folder containing entity .md files (characters, locations, factions, objects, concepts, arcs), plus the glossary/, timeline/, and notes/ subfolders.

imports.description: Drop-zone folder for existing source docs/bibles to migrate via the 'Migrate Existing Lore' command.

hiddenCategories.description: World-tree category ids to hide from the sidebar (e.g. a project with no Factions or Arcs can hide those sections without deleting anything).
